protocol: Stack release candidate 1002b on native MTP: three levers on by default. Prefix caching (one flag flipped in place in profiles/serve-args.json, the same token the APC q5 kit flipped for glm53full-apcq-20261002-121736-b5); native MTP K-stop with the uniform-batch policy (environment), which makes the launcher select K3, capture sizes [1, 4, 16] and the 544-block KV pool; the short-context DSA shortcut off, because K-stop and the shortcut transform the same pinned sources. Native MTP shard selection (boot-fast-profile.json) is unchanged. skip-mla-plan, spec-sample and the dispram hook add no default key.
